arxiv-1712-05373.title: Sensing behavior of acetone vapors on TiO 2 nanostructures — application of density functional theory
arxiv-1712-05373.creator: V. Nagarajan, S. Sriram, R. Chandiramouli
arxiv-1712-05373.description: Abstract The electronic properties of TiO 2 nanostructure are explored using density functional theory. The adsorption properties of acetone on TiO 2 nanostructure are studied in terms of adsorption energy, average energy gap variation and Mulliken charge transfer. The density of states spectrum and the band structure clearly reveals the adsorption of acetone on TiO 2 nanostructures.

arxiv-2012-09238.title: Early fault-tolerant simulations of the Hubbard model
arxiv-2012-09238.creator: Earl T. Campbell
arxiv-2012-09238.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Earl T. Campbell. Simulation of the Hubbard model is a leading candidate for the first useful applications of a fault-tolerant quantum computer. A recent study of quantum algorithms for early simulations of the Hubbard model [Kivlichan et al. Quantum 4 296 (2019)] found that the lowest resource costs were achieved by split-operator Trotterization combined with the fast-fermionic Fourier transform (FFFT) on an L × L L\times L lattice with length L = 2 k L=2^{k} .

arxiv-2104-07258.title: Two-band Conduction and Nesting Instabilities in Superconducting Ba 2 CuO 3+δ : a First Principles Study
arxiv-2104-07258.creator: Hyo-Sun Jin 1, Warren E. Pickett 2, Kwan-Woo Lee 1,3
arxiv-2104-07258.description: Abstract First principles investigations of the high temperature superconducting system Ba 2 CuO 3+δ , recently discovered at δ ≈ 0.2 \delta\approx 0.2 at T c = 70 T_{c}=70 K, are applied to demonstrate the effects of oxygen ordering on the electronic and magnetic properties.

arxiv-2106-06307.title: Survey of Image Based Graph Neural Networks
arxiv-2106-06307.creator: U. Nazir, H. Wang, M. Taj
arxiv-2106-06307.description: Abstract In this survey paper, we analyze image based graph neural networks and propose a three-step classification approach. We first convert the image into superpixels using the Quickshift algorithm so as to reduce 30 % 30\% of the input data. The superpixels are subsequently used to generate a region adjacency graph.

arxiv-2210-16586.title: NTULM: Enriching Social Media Text Representations with Non-Textual Units
arxiv-2210-16586.creator: Jinning Li, Shubhanshu Mishra, Ahmed El-Kishky, Sneha Mehta, Vivek Kulkarni
arxiv-2210-16586.description: Abstract On social media, additional context is often present in the form of annotations and meta-data such as the post’s author, mentions, Hashtags, and hyperlinks. We refer to these annotations as Non-Textual Units (NTUs). We posit that NTUs provide social context beyond their textual semantics and leveraging these units can enrich social media text representations.

arxiv-2307-05590.title: Efficient Computation of Magnetic Polarizability Tensor Spectral Signatures for Object Characterisation in Metal Detection
arxiv-2307-05590.creator: J. Elgy, P.D. Ledger
arxiv-2307-05590.description: Abstract Abstract Purpose: Magnetic polarizability tensors (MPTs) provide an economical characterisation of conducting magnetic metallic objects and their spectral signature can aid in the solution of metal detection inverse problems, such as scrap metal sorting, searching for unexploded ordnance in areas of former conflict, and security screening at event venues and transport hubs.

arxiv-2309-00490.title: Small weight codewords of projective geometric codes II
arxiv-2309-00490.creator: Sam Adriaensen, Lins Denaux
arxiv-2309-00490.description: Abstract The p p -ary linear code 𝒞 k ​ ( n , q ) \mathcal{C}_{k}\!\left(n,q\right) is defined as the row space of the incidence matrix A A of k k -spaces and points of PG ⁡ ( n , q ) \mathrm{PG}\!\left(n,q\right) .

arxiv-2402-00432.title: Density fluctuations for Squeezed Number State and Coherent Squeezed Number State in Flat FRW Universe
arxiv-2402-00432.creator: Dhwani Gangal, Sudhava Yadav, K.K. Venkataratnam
arxiv-2402-00432.description: Abstract We study the density fluctuations for Coherent Squeezed Number State (CSNS) and Squeezed Number States (SNS) formalism in Semiclassical theory of gravity in flat FRW universe. We used Number state evolution of oscillatory phase of inflaton for coherent squeezed number state and squeezed number states formalisms.

arxiv-2404-01819.title: Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queries for Semi-Supervised Object Detection
arxiv-2404-01819.creator: Tahira Shehzadi, Khurram Azeem Hashmi, Didier Stricker, Muhammad Zeshan Afzal
arxiv-2404-01819.description: Abstract In this paper, we address the limitations of the DETR-based semi-supervised object detection (SSOD) framework, particularly focusing on the challenges posed by the quality of object queries. In DETR-based SSOD, the one-to-one assignment strategy provides inaccurate pseudo-labels, while the one-to-many assignments strategy leads to overlapping predictions.

arxiv-2407-08947.title: Constructing Concept-based Models to Mitigate Spurious Correlations with Minimal Human Effort
arxiv-2407-08947.creator: Jeeyung Kim, Ze Wang, Qiang Qiu
arxiv-2407-08947.description: Abstract Enhancing model interpretability can address spurious correlations by revealing how models draw their predictions. Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) can provide a principled way of disclosing and guiding model behaviors through human-understandable concepts, albeit at a high cost of human efforts in data annotation.

arxiv-2411-08133.title: Impactful Bit-Flip Search on Full-precision Models
arxiv-2411-08133.creator: Matan Levy, Nadav Benedek, Mahmood Sharif
arxiv-2411-08133.description: Abstract . Neural networks have shown remarkable performance in various tasks, yet they remain susceptible to subtle changes in their input or model parameters. One particularly impactful vulnerability arises through the Bit-Flip Attack (BFA), where flipping a small number of critical bits in a model’s parameters can severely degrade its performance.

arxiv-2412-15709.title: Optimal dual pairs of frames for erasures
arxiv-2412-15709.creator: S. Arati, P. Devaraj, Shankhadeep Mondal
arxiv-2412-15709.description: Abstract The study involves characterizations of dual pairs of frames which are optimal to handle erasures among all dual pairs for a finite dimensional Hilbert space. A new optimality measure using the Frobenius norm of the error operator has been introduced and the corresponding optimal dual pairs have been analyzed for any number of erasures.

arxiv-2504-20279.title: Strong Gelfand Pairs of the symplectic group 𝐒𝐩 4 ​ ( q CLOSE \boldsymbol{\rm Sp}_{4}(q ) where q q is even
arxiv-2504-20279.creator: Stephen P. Humphries, Joseph E. Marrow
arxiv-2504-20279.description: Abstract . A strong Gelfand pair ( G , H ) (G,H) is a finite group G G together with a subgroup H H such that every irreducible character of H H induces to a multiplicity-free character of G G .

arxiv-2601-17279.title: SPADE : A SIMD Posit-enabled compute engine for Accelerating DNN Efficiency
arxiv-2601-17279.creator: Sonu Kumar , Lavanya Vinnakota , Mukul Lokhande, Santosh Kumar Vishvakarma, Adam Teman
arxiv-2601-17279.description: Abstract The growing demand for edge-AI systems requires arithmetic units that balance numerical precision, energy efficiency, and compact hardware while supporting diverse formats. Posit arithmetic offers advantages over floating- and fixed-point representations through its tapered precision, wide dynamic range, and improved numerical robustness.

arxiv-2601-21256.title: Earth-Density Effects in LBL Experiments: A Comprehensive Review of Theory, Observations, and Future Directions
arxiv-2601-21256.creator: Tia Pandit, Bipin Singh Koranga
arxiv-2601-21256.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Tia Pandit, Bipin Singh Koranga. Earth matter density uncertainties play a non-trivial role in three-flavour neutrino oscillations in matter, particularly for the ν μ → ν e \nu_{\mu}\rightarrow\nu_{e} appearance channel. This underpins CP-violation measurements in long-baseline experiments. We demonstrate that when realistic spatial variations of the Earth’s density are taken into account, oscillation probabilities acquire additional energy-dependent structure that cannot be captured by path-averaged density approximations.

pmc-10504046.title: Antiviral Drugs and Vaccines for Omicron Variant: A Focused Review
pmc-10504046.creator: Nidhi Garg, Ananya Sree Kunamneni, Pankaj Garg, Sandeep Sharma, Divakar Sharma, Adinarayana Kunamneni
pmc-10504046.description: The Omicron variant of concern (VOC) replaced the delta variant rapidly and became the predominant strain due to more mutations in spike protein and receptor-binding domain (RBD) enhancing its infectivity and binding affinity. The severity of the illness is less than that of the delta variant. Omicron is nonsusceptible to REGEN-COV™ and bamlanivimab with etesevimab.

pmc-10603701.title: Identifying the Risk Regions of Wild Boar (Sus scrofa) Incidents in China
pmc-10603701.creator: Boming Zheng, Xijie Lin, Xinhua Qi, Emiliano Mori
pmc-10603701.description: Simple SummaryIdentifying the risk regions of human–wildlife conflict is a pertinent topic in current human–wildlife conflict research. Most of the existing studies obtained their wildlife incident information through field surveys to identify risk regions. However, field surveys require a lot of personnel, time, and money.

pmc-11334073.title: Gene Transfer Among Viruses Substantially Contributes to Gene Gain of Giant Viruses
pmc-11334073.creator: Junyi Wu, Lingjie Meng, Morgan Gaïa, Hiroyuki Hikida, Yusuke Okazaki, Hisashi Endo, Hiroyuki Ogata, Fabia Ursula Battistuzzi
pmc-11334073.description: The phylum Nucleocytoviricota comprises a diverse group of double-stranded DNA viruses that display a wide range of gene repertoires. Although these gene repertoires determine the characteristics of individual viruses, the evolutionary processes that have shaped the gene repertoires of extant viruses since their common ancestor are poorly characterized.

pmc-11406785.title: Impact of propofol versus desflurane anesthesia on postoperative hepatic and renal functions in infants with living-related liver transplantation: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-11406785.creator: Wei Liu, Min Du, Mingman Zhang, Xiaoke Dai, Haoming Wang, Ying Le, Shenshen Zhi, Lin Bo, Junjun Quan
pmc-11406785.description: BackgroundThe effects of anesthetics on liver and kidney functions after infantile living-related liver transplantation (LRLT) are unclear. This study aimed to investigate the effects of propofol-based total intravenous anesthesia (TIVA) or desflurane-based inhalation anesthesia on postoperative liver and kidney functions in infant recipients after LRLT and to evaluate hepatic ischemia–reperfusion injury (HIRI).

pmc-11608240.title: Creep characterisation and microstructural analysis of municipal solid waste incineration fly ash geopolymer backfill
pmc-11608240.creator: Lijuan Su, Siyao Wu, Guosheng Fu, Wancheng Zhu, Xiangdong Zhang, Bing Liang
pmc-11608240.description: In this work, an alkali-activated municipal solid waste incineration (MSWI) fly ash-based filling material was prepared with MSWI fly ash as the raw material and slag as the auxiliary material. The filling body experiences long-term creep, which may have a direct effect on the stability of the overlying strata of the mine goaf.

pmc-11656153.title: Highly Durable Inverted Inorganic Perovskite/Organic Tandem Solar Cells Enabled by Multifunctional Additives
pmc-11656153.creator: Yanxun Li, Yichao Yan, Yuang Fu, Wenlin Jiang, Ming Liu, Mingqian Chen, Xiaofeng Huang, Guanghao Lu, Xinhui Lu, Jun Yin, Shengfan Wu, Alex K.‐Y. Jen
pmc-11656153.description: Inverted perovskite/organic tandem solar cells (P/O TSCs) suffer from poor long‐term device stability due to halide segregation in organic–inorganic hybrid wide‐band gap (WBG) perovskites, which hinders their practical deployment. Therefore, developing all‐inorganic WBG perovskites for incorporation into P/O TSCs is a promising strategy because of their superior stability under continuous illumination.

pmc-13199533.title: Design-based life cycle assessment of flexible pavements to evaluate embodied carbon footprint
pmc-13199533.creator: Praveen Bodhanam S, Ramu Baadiga
pmc-13199533.description: Material-intensive infrastructure systems, such as flexible pavements, offer significant opportunities for reducing resource consumption and associated life-cycle environmental impacts through design-level interventions. This study integrates structural performance metrics, specifically modulus improvement factor (MIF), into life cycle assessment (LCA) decision-making for pavements. The life cycle carbon emissions of conventional and sustainably reinforced pavements were evaluated.

pmc-13217949.title: Celastrol ameliorates atherosclerosis by inhibiting TLR4/STAT3/NLRP3-mediated macrophage pyroptosis
pmc-13217949.creator: Yaning Shi, Ziyi Li, Qizhi Liu, Yun Qiu, Junpeng Long, Qiong Yang, Chanjuan Zhang, Yongzhen Gong, Li Qin
pmc-13217949.description: BackgroundAtherosclerosis is a chronic inflammatory disease characterized by plaque formation. Macrophage pyroptosis critically contributes to the formation and expansion of necrotic core as well as the instability of atherosclerotic plaque. Celastrol is a pentacyclic triterpene derived from the root of Tripterygium wilfordii Hook F, which has powerful anti-inflammatory properties.

pmc-13391500.title: Digital health literacy and its behavioral correlates among medical undergraduates in central China: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13391500.creator: Yu Wang, Jiamin Wang, Bin Wei, Ying Wang, Zhengrong Zhou, Zhuoyun Wang
pmc-13391500.description: BackgroundDigital health literacy (DHL) is a core competency for future healthcare workers, yet its predictors determinants among medical undergraduates in Central China remain unclear.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted among 1,130 medical undergraduates in Anhui Province using stratified cluster sampling. DHL was assessed using the validated Chinese version of the eHealth Literacy Scale (eHEALS).

pmc-13582317.title: Evaluation of the diagnostic value of dual-time-point, multi-parameter 99mTc-PYP imaging in diagnosing Transthyretin Cardiac Amyloidosis
pmc-13582317.creator: Jinyong Luo, Lihua Ji, Qingfei Dong, Qingqian Kong, Ting Chen, Weihong Yuan
pmc-13582317.description: Objective To assess the clinical value of dual-time-point planar imaging and SPECT/CT tomographic imaging of 99mTc-PYP in diagnosing transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis (ATTR-CA), and to compare the diagnostic performance of different imaging time points and methods. Methods A retrospective analysis of 98 suspected CA patients (ATTR-CA 12; AL-CA 23; non-CA 63).
